texts.value: Catalyzes the transfer of phosphatidylinositol (PI) and phosphatidylcholine (PC) between membranes (PubMed:10531358, PubMed:14962392, PubMed:15522822, PubMed:18636990, PubMed:22822086). Shows a preference for PI and PC containing shorter saturated or monosaturated acyl chains at the sn-1 and sn-2 positions (PubMed:15522822, PubMed:22822086). Preference order for PC is C16:1 > C16:0 > C18:1 > C18:0 > C20:4 and for PI is C16:1 > C16:0 > C18:1 > C18:0 > C20:4 > C20:3 (PubMed:22822086)
Phosphatidylinositol transfer activity is inhibited by N-ethylmaleimide
Primarily localized in the cytosol in its closed state, is enriched on membranes in its open state where it facilitates lipid transfer
Belongs to the PtdIns transfer protein family. PI transfer class I subfamily
